item.title: Man Climbs Telecom Tower at Jagti Mini Township Over Shop Allotment Grievance
item.description: JAMMU: A man climbed a telecom tower on Wednesday to protest against the relief department after he was not allotted a shop under the Jagti Kashmiri Pandit migrant mini township on the outskirts of the city, officials said. item.title: Delhi Enforces BS-VI Entry Ban, ‘No PUC, No Fuel’ Rule to Curb Air Pollution
item.description: NEW DELHI: The ban on the entry of non-Delhi private vehicles below BS-VI emission standards came into force in the national capital on Thursday, along with the enforcement of the ‘No PUC, No Fuel’ rule, as authorities intensified measures to combat worsening air pollution. item.title: Kolhapur’s Saee Jadhav becomes first woman Territorial Army officer to pass out of IMA
item.description: PUNE: Saee Jadhav from Maharashtra’s Kolhapur has become the first woman Territorial Army officer to complete pre-commissioning training at the Indian Military Academy (IMA), Dehradun, breaking the institution’s 93-year-old tradition of male-only officer training. Chief Minister Devendra Fadnavis congratulated her and said her achievement is an inspiring milestone that gives direction to the dreams of [...]

item.title: J&K Police arrests 3 persons involved in sacrilegious act in Doda
item.description: DODA: Police on Thursday have three persons in connection with an alleged sacrilegious act in Jammu and Kashmir’s Doda district, officials said. item.title: Stock markets trade lower in early deals
item.description: MUMBAI: Equity benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty edged lower in early trade on Thursday tracking a weak trend in global markets. item.description: KOCHI: An Air India Express flight from Jeddah to Kozhikode with 160 passengers carried out an emergency landing at the Cochin International Airport here on Thursday due to issues involving its landing gear and tyre failure, an official said.
